id.description: A short code for this person. Example: smith-john. Every other file points at the person with this code.

name.description: Full name, written per language. Example: { "en": "John Smith", "el": "Τζον Σμιθ" }

rank.description: One of: professor, associate_professor, assistant_professor, lecturer, teaching_staff, researcher, visiting, other

other_title.description: Only when the rank is other: the person's own title, written per language. Example: { "en": "Reader" }

sector.description: The id of this person's sector (from sectors.json)

status.description: One of: active, on_leave, retired, emeritus, former. Leave out if active. Use former for people who left: keep them in the list so old years can still refer to them.

first_year.description: First academic year this person taught here (optional). Example: 2015-2016

last_year.description: Last academic year this person taught here (optional). Example: 2023-2024

meeting_hours.description: When students can meet this person, written per language. Example: { "en": "Mondays 10:00 to 12:00" }
